map.abstract: Archaeological Artefact Database of Finland (AADA). AADA contains three main periods: Stone Age, Bronze Age and Iron Age. Each of these contains both period-specific and general artefact categories. The general categories are pottery, stone tools, bone tools, clay artefacts and wooden artefacts. Please cite: Pesonen, P., Moilanen, U., Roose, M., Saipio, J., Tiilikkala, J., Sanwal, U., Immonen, V., Vesakoski, O. & Onkamo, P. (2024). Archaeological Artefact Database of Finland (AADA). Scientific Data 11, 815. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-024-03602-8

layers.description:
Iron Age bone artefacts from the Archaeological Artefact Database of Finland (AADA) (98 records). The data is based on the archival survey of the Kipot and Kielet project. The owners of this dataset are Petro Pesonen (petro.pesonen@gmail.com), Ulla Moilanen, Jarkko Saipio, Jasse Tiilikkala and the Department of Biology, University of Turku.

Citation: Pesonen, P., Moilanen, U., Roose, M., Saipio, J., Tiilikkala, J., Sanwal, U., Immonen, V., Vesakoski, O. & Onkamo, P. (2024). Archaeological Artefact Database of Finland (AADA). Scientific Data 11, 815. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-024-03602-8
